title: Resume Gaps? Say This Instead (One Sentence That Removes Doubt)
description:
If you’ve ever worried a resume gap disqualified you — this is for you.

This Short shows how to explain an employment gap with one calm, confident sentence that removes doubt and keeps your credibility intact — without over-explaining or apologizing.

 This video is linked to my longer breakdown on how to explain different types of work gaps (parenting, medical leave, layoffs, caregiving, and more) and what recruiters actually care about.

No drama. No excuses. Just clarity.

For copy-and-paste-ready examples to explain work gaps, check out my Get Seen Job Search Guide here:

transcript: Mom, where's my basketball jersey? Hey, Mom. I need you to help bite my butt. MOM, HURRY UP, POP. Even me? Girl, most definitely you. First of all, you ran a literal show for the past 5 years, which means problem solving, logistics, crisis management, creativity, patience at an elite level. You are at an I can bring corporate America to its knees level. But since we can't say boss lady show on your resume, here's what we do instead. This works for all parents, stay-at-home dads, I see you, too. Chaos isn't just luck for the moms. We simply add one calm, competent sentence to our professional summary that removes any doubt and explains what we've been doing for the last 5 years. From 2022 to 2025, took a planned parenting pause, strengthening problem solving, organization, adaptability, and resilience. now energized and ready to re-enter the workforce. This removes any questions as to what you were doing for five years and frames you as someone capable and confident to get back into the workforce.
